entries.summary: Security fixes; CVE-2026-129344: Sending a channel message that cannot be serialized can lead to a denial of service for all clients on a shared topic; CVE-2026-128361: Unsanitized presence key crashes Presence tracker.
entries.text: Security fixes CVE-2026-129344: Sending a channel message that cannot be serialized can lead to a denial of service for all clients on a shared topic CVE-2026-128361: Unsanitized presence key crashes Presence tracker Bug fixes [Phoenix.PubSub] an Endpoint broadcast now works even when the endpoint is not started (#6846) [phoenix.js] Send the fallback health check before a buffered join (#6770) Enhancements [phoenix.js] Allow enabling reconnections while a tab is hidden with reconnectWhenHidden (#6883) [Channels] send fastlane messages as shared binaries (#6884) Store verified route warnings relative to cwd (#6889) Support binary messages in LongPoll transport
